summary: First-party executable Provider plugin for Meshy 3D generation and auto-rigging, bound to the built-in meshy-6, meshy-7, and meshy-auto-rig model cards.
context_hints: This plugin contributes no model cards. meshy-6, meshy-7, and meshy-auto-rig are built-in Host cards owned elsewhere; this plugin only binds Provider routes to them.

meshy-6 and meshy-7 each accept a text prompt plus an optional single image reference. The executor calls Text to 3D (preview, then refine) when no image is attached, and Image to 3D (single stage) when exactly one image is attached.
meshy-auto-rig is model-to-model: it takes exactly one model reference (a textured humanoid GLB) and calls the Rigging API in a single stage.

Text to 3D is Meshy's only two-stage route: submit creates the preview task; poll advances the preview to SUCCEEDED, submits the refine task from the same poll cycle, and keeps polling the refine task until it, too, completes.

Image and model references are resolved through context.reference into a provider-fetchable URL or a base64 data URI -- never a clash-asset:// handle, and never a Host-local executor-url an external Provider cannot reach.

Only five parameters cross the wire: PBR (enable_pbr), textureResolution (texture_resolution), poseMode (pose_mode), targetPolycount (target_polycount, which also turns on should_remesh), and heightMeters (height_meters, rigging only).
GLB is the only output format requested (target_formats: ["glb"]) and the only format returned; media outputs are always kind "model" with mediaType model/gltf-binary.

subdirectories.providers: Meshy Provider declaration and API-key form.
subdirectories.bindings: Model Provider bindings routing meshy-6, meshy-7, and meshy-auto-rig to this Provider.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, the pure Meshy REST executor, and the Host-facing adapter.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations (no cards).
key_files.providers/meshy.json: Provider metadata and API-key auth form.
key_files.bindings/meshy-6.json: Binds the meshy-6 card to this Provider's ai_model "meshy-6".
key_files.bindings/meshy-7.json: Binds the meshy-7 card to this Provider's ai_model "meshy-7".
key_files.bindings/meshy-auto-rig.json: Binds the meshy-auto-rig card to Meshy's Rigging task type "rig".
key_files.src/meshy-executor.ts: Pure Meshy REST request builders, submit/poll calls, and task-status/error classification.
key_files.src/meshy-adapter.ts: Host-facing wiring: credential lookup, reference resolution, route dispatch, and durable poll-state (de)serialization.
